pattern_library.P-001: stub-dunder-AttributeError: Module __getattr__ MUST raise AttributeError for dunder names
pattern_library.P-002: torch-stub-real-getattr: _real branch MUST define __getattr__ for subpackage delegation
pattern_library.P-003: duplicate-logger-warning: Use single logger.debug for recoverable exceptions
pattern_library.P-004: monkeypatch-module-ref: Production code MUST call module.func() via module-ref for monkeypatch
pattern_library.P-005: defusedxml-lazy-importlib: Optional security packages loaded via importlib.import_module
pattern_library.P-006: cudnn-enabled-guard: Check cudnn.enabled (not device.type or dtype) for determinism; raise AssertionError
pattern_library.P-007: faiss-availability-check: Import the dependency directly (import faiss) before importing wrapper class
pattern_library.P-008: load-training-arguments-stub: HF trainer tests MUST stub load_training_arguments to prevent CUDA probe
pattern_library.P-009: checkpoint-sha256-embed: Embed digest into re-serialized bytes before write; upsert parent-index by root.name
pattern_library.P-010: embedding-cache-set: EmbeddingCache.set(key, value, *args) delegates to put(); non-numeric falls back to np.zeros(1)
pattern_library.P-011: getattr-compat-guard: Use getattr(obj, attr, default) for dependency attributes that may be removed in minor/major upgrades
pattern_library.P-012: facade-class-testability: Create facade classes (e.g. RAGIndexer) to enable @patch in tests when module only exposes functions
